author: HR agent
text: Mary Lee is an Analyst. As a full-time employee, she is eligible for up to write access for systems not owned by her role. Since she requested admin, I recommend capping it at write.

author: Security agent
text: The Security database indicates Mary Lee is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors are limited to read access unless they have advanced training. Since she requested admin, I recommend capping her access at read.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors can have read access, or write access only if they have advanced security training. Since they only have basic training, the maximum allowed level is read. Requested write access exceeds the maximum allowed for this employee type/training level.
